- **Goal-Based Wealth Planner**: Computes targeted monthly SIP and lumpsum requirements for retirement, child higher education, dream house, and marriage goals with custom inflation and expected CAGR. (https://milestonefinancial.in/goal-planner.html)
- **Advanced SIP Calculator**: Calculates wealth accumulation, total invested capital, estimated returns, and step-up compounding with visual growth charts. (https://milestonefinancial.in/sip-calculator.html)
- **Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) Calculator**: Simulates post-retirement monthly income generation with both Year-wise and Month-wise cash flow breakdowns and final corpus balance. (https://milestonefinancial.in/swp-calculator.html)
- **Lump Sum Investment Calculator**: Projects the future value of one-time mutual fund investments across 1 to 30 years. (https://milestonefinancial.in/lumpsum-calculator.html)
